title: INITIALIZE sets numeric fields to ZERO and alphanumeric to SPACES — REPLACING overrides per category
sourceContent:
IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
       PROGRAM-ID. INIT-RECORD.
       DATA DIVISION.
       WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
       01  WS-CUST.
           05  CUST-ID    PIC 9(8).
           05  CUST-NAME  PIC X(20).
           05  CUST-FLAG  PIC X.
      *> INITIALIZE walks the group and sets:
      *>   numeric (9, V) -> ZERO
      *>   alphanumeric (X, A) -> SPACE
      *> Filler items are skipped. REPLACING ALPHANUMERIC BY "-"
      *> overrides the default for alphanumerics in one category at a
      *> time -- NOT per field.
       PROCEDURE DIVISION.
           INITIALIZE WS-CUST.
           STOP RUN.
notes: INITIALIZE's per-category default is subtle. Java's 'new Record()' sets numeric to 0 and reference types to null — which is NOT the same as space. The spec must capture the per-category rules so the rewrite uses explicit defaults.
